invariants.rationale: Method stores computation output in 'result'; invariants should assume it is non-null.
'result.setWriteStatuses(statuses)' is always called, so its value should be set and not null.
'result.setIndexUpdateDuration' is set unconditionally in the method.
The method assigns 'result.setPartitionToReplaceFileIds', so the value should always be set and not null.
The method sets WriteStatuses with a List<WriteStatus> (from updateLocation().collectAsList()), so this should always be a List.
